notes: Empty arg yields "What do you want to quaff?".
get_obj_in_list_vis miss yields "You don't seem to have a/an X.".
Carrying lookup is keyword-prefix (get_obj_in_list_vis); a short-desc-only arg ("invisible" on "a yellow potion of see invisible") must miss.

Quaffing a potion casts each of vals[1..3] via CallMagic(ch, ch, CAST_POTION), breaking on the first miss; proven with potion 8051 (see-invisible) emitting "Your eyes tingle.". Damage/points spells (RNG dice) and multi-spell potions are a tracked follow-up.

Per-spell to_vict/to_room/to_self effect messages for affect potions are owned by the object-magic manifest (docs/fidelity/depth/object-magic.tsv); quaff-bless/detect-magic/change-density/invulnerability/chameleon/sanctuary/fly/prot-evil/prot-good scenarios prove them live.
